title: Flower pot with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pot body -->
  <path d='M28 58 L72 58 L67 90 Q66 94 62 94 L38 94 Q34 94 33 90 Z' fill='#D2691E'/>
  <!-- pot rim -->
  <rect x='23' y='50' width='54' height='11' rx='4' fill='#E8873A'/>
  <!-- pot rim highlight -->
  <rect x='26' y='52' width='48' height='4' rx='2' fill='#F2A65A'/>
  <!-- pot body highlight stripe -->
  <path d='M31 62 L34 88 L38 88 L35 62 Z' fill='#E8873A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='18' ry='6' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='14' ry='4' fill='#7A4E28'/>
  <!-- flower stem -->
  <line x1='50' y1='54' x2='50' y2='28' stroke='#3CB043' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- leaf left -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='42' rx='8' ry='4.5' fill='#4CD964' transform='rotate(-30 41 42)'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='42' x2='47' y2='44' stroke='#2E9E34' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- leaf right -->
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='36' rx='8' ry='4.5' fill='#4CD964' transform='rotate(30 59 36)'/>
  <line x1='59' y1='36' x2='53' y2='38' stroke='#2E9E34' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- flower petals -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='7' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='7' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='24' r='7' fill='#FF7090'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='24' r='7' fill='#FF7090'/>
  <!-- flower center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='5' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- smiling face on pot -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='71' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#3B1F0B'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='71' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#3B1F0B'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='41.2' cy='69.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61.2' cy='69.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M41 79 Q50 87 59 79' stroke='#3B1F0B' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='78' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF8080' opacity='0.65'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='78' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF8080' opacity='0.65'/>
</svg>
